sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the repaired hullStructure ownership and unit IRIs. Add an explicit SHACL datatype constraint for nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied as xsd:boolean on the same web/flange nodes, with appropriate cardinality for the required evidence, rather than relying only on the SPARQL literal test. Retain the linear-method applicability, calculation-case path, operand/result paths, and strict less-than DIRECT_CHECK comparisons.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the ownership/domain of nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied. Its declared requiredOwner and canonical domain are nltl:hullStructure, but the candidate constrains it on nodes typed only as nltl:structuralMemberWeb and nltl:structuralMemberFlange. Constrain the applicable hullStructure owner (or explicitly make the same canonical owner node a hullStructure without duplicating or relocating the web/flange facts), while preserving the required linear-method applicability and the two DIRECT_CHECK comparisons.

Preserve the prior ownership repair: nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied has requiredOwner nltl:hullStructure, but it is currently constrained on nodes typed only as nltl:structuralMemberWeb and nltl:structuralMemberFlange. Add nltl:hullStructure as an additional class for the same web/flange owner nodes (without duplicating or relocating their facts), or otherwise constrain the applicable hullStructure owner while retaining the existing web/flange paths, linear-method applicability, operands, units, and DIRECT_CHECK comparisons.

Preserve the repaired hullStructure ownership for nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied and retain all existing applicability, operand, relationship, evidence, and DIRECT_CHECK structures. Repair every quantity unit: qudt:MegaPA currently expands under the schema namespace (http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/MegaPA), but the canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA; bind a unit prefix to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and use that IRI for yieldStrength, nominalShearStress, and nominalFlangeVonMisesStress.

Preserve the repaired hullStructure ownership and unit IRIs. Add an explicit SHACL datatype constraint for nltl:bucklingCriteriaSatisfied as xsd:boolean on the same web/flange nodes, with appropriate cardinality for the required evidence, rather than relying only on the SPARQL literal test. Retain the linear-method applicability, calculation-case path, operand/result paths, and strict less-than DIRECT_CHECK comparisons.
